subject: mathematics
concept: Equivalent fractions and finding a fraction equivalent to a given one
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student overlays virtual fraction tiles of different sizes to find matching shaded amounts
exercise.pictorial: Student shades a second bar model to match a given fraction's shaded amount
exercise.abstract: Student generates equivalent fractions by multiplying or dividing numerator and denominator

misconception_flags: multiplies only the numerator or only the denominator, not both

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
